cards.stem: In simplified level motion, what happens when weight drops but lift stays steady?
cards.quote: If the weight is decreased while the lift is held constant, the airplane will rise:
cards.hint: Focus on which vertical force is greater.

cards.stem: In simplified vertical motion, what follows when lift becomes less than weight?
cards.hint: Compare lift and weight to find direction.

cards.stem: In simplified forward motion, what follows when thrust exceeds drag?
cards.hint: Compare thrust and drag to find outcome.

cards.stem: In simplified forward motion, what follows when drag exceeds thrust?
cards.hint: Think which horizontal force is larger.
